name: process_refund
description: Issue a refund against an order. The order must already be cancelled or returned: refunding a pending, processing, shipped or delivered order is rejected, so cancel first when the customer wants their money back on an unshipped order. Omitting amount refunds everything still outstanding; partial refunds may be repeated up to the order total, and remaining_refundable reports what is left.

amount.description: Amount in USD. Omit to refund the full outstanding balance.

error_returns.when: No order exists with the given order_id.
method is not one of the listed values, amount is not positive, or amount exceeds the balance still refundable.
The order is not cancelled or returned, or it has already been refunded in full.
